entities.name: Methyl tetrafluoropropoxypyridinecarboxylate
observations: Decoded main reactant: methyl 5-[2,2,3,3-tetrafluoropropoxy]pyridine-2-carboxylate, SMILES COC(=O)c1ccc(OCC(F)(F)C(F)F)cn1.

entities.name: Tetrahydrofuran
observations: Second organic component decodes to tetrahydrofuran and is likely the reaction solvent.

entities.name: Ester saponification
observations: Aqueous lithium hydroxide promotes hydrolysis of the methyl ester to the corresponding carboxylate; acidic workup gives the carboxylic acid.

entities.name: Tetrafluoropropoxypyridinecarboxylic acid
observations: Likely isolated product after workup: 5-[2,2,3,3-tetrafluoropropoxy]pyridine-2-carboxylic acid, SMILES O=C(O)c1ccc(OCC(F)(F)C(F)F)cn1.

entities.name: Lithium tetrafluoropropoxypyridinecarboxylate
observations: Under unacidified basic conditions, the product is expected predominantly as the lithium carboxylate: [Li+].O=C([O-])c1ccc(OCC(F)(F)C(F)F)cn1.
